dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately 4-6 prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible on the mid-lateral flank, characterized by thin, high-intensity light perimeters that sharply transition to darker interior pixel values.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid high-intensity light pixel clusters observed primarily along the dorsal ridge and towards the posterior transition to the tail.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most distinct lateral annuli form an irregular, elongated pentagonal spatial arrangement oriented along the horizontal axis of the torso.
